[Do or Die]
The strongest enemies can go into a 'do or die' state when their
HP drops low enough. You can't be too careful when this happens.
'Do or Die' gives the enemy an increased number of attacks per turn.
If they use too many strong attacks at once, you might end up
being the one in trouble.
They'll also become immune to status effects like Blind, Silence,
Confusion, Paralysis, and Sleep. You'll need to use strategy to
defeat these enemies.

[Books]
Records describing the experiences of our predecessors is called a
book. Reading one gives you a chunk of XP.
This can help lower-level characters to catch up to the party, or
give higher-level characters a further boost.
The strongest enemies don't give XP, they drop Books instead.
Only common enemies give XP when you defeat them. Know what
that means?
If you skip fighting weak enemies and only go for the strong ones,
you're in for a world of pain. It'll probably appeal to those who
like a tough challenge, though.
パーシアス
[Holy Land Pacius]
Pacius was created at the beginning of the world. God created three
humans, and left them there.
The three were called Sages, and shared their insights with the
ever-growing human population. They taught mankind how to use
words, how to hunt, and how to build their own homes.
The Sages are undying, constantly reborn into the world. Those
who have lost their way in life go to Pacius to be guided by the
Sages to a happier life.

クミン
[Neutral Republic of Kumin]
A country of absolute neutrality. Kumin has immense economic
power due to its advanced mithril processing technology.
Being situated next to the Empire, Kumin has faced many great
difficulties. At one point it came close to being wiped
out completely.
Kumin's Radiant Tower is a popular tourist attraction. It has
furniture on display that's over 1,000 years old and attracts
over two million visitors a year.

[Kingdom of Bohelos]
Saint Bohelos descended upon this unclean world and founded
a country to save the peasants.
With the support of many other countries, Bohelos was able to
reject the Empire's policy of aristocracy. Lace was founded later,
and based its own ideals on those of Bohelos.
These peaceful ideals have survived to the present day. The many
incredible citizens have maintained them through many wars and
natural disasters.
Once the country found peace, Saint Bohelos returned to the
Land of God.
[The Empire]
With a thousand years of history, the Empire is the largest country
on the continent. It presides over the laws of the other countries.
The Empire inspects the distribution of all goods, maintains records
of every person born, and controls everyone who becomes a peasant.
Since the implementation of the Empire's oversight, the number of
wars has diminished and the economy has grown stronger. Mankind
enjoys a peaceful world under the Empire's patronage.

[Achievements]
When you accomplish something big, you get an achievement.
They're medals for those who have overcome challenges.
Still, they're purely decorative. They don't provide any bonuses.
The joy of possessing them is all you get.
[Attributes - Volume 2]
To make an attack with an attribute, you need to use magic with
that attribute to attack... Or, an attributed weapon.
There's a low chance of getting an attributed weapon as a drop from
special monsters. Try farming the same monsters over and over to
make things easier down the road.
[Attributes - Volume 1]
There are many types of attributes. Fire, water, lightning... Use
them to take advantage of an enemy's weakness for an easier fight.
Enemies from the same area often share the same weaknesses. For
example, enemies from Tortas tend to be weak to water.
You can find out the local enemies are weak to by asking around.
Intelligence gathering is a vital part of warfare.
[Attacks and Skills]
Skills are very useful in battle, but sometimes normal attacks can
be the way to go.
If your skills don't seem to be doing much damage to the enemy,
try checking your equipment or using normal attacks against
them instead.
[Cover]
This skill uses one character to protect the others. It's best used
by someone with a high defense.
It doesn't always have to be the hardiest character who uses it,
though. Don't be afraid to try out new things. It's always worth
testing something new out.
[Back Attack]
If you touch the back of an enemy that hasn't spotted you, you'll
initiate a Back Attack.
Back Attacks give you an advantage by forcing the enemy to fight
while they're unprepared and confused.
You also get better drop rates from battles that start with a Back
Attack. Use it when you're aiming for rare items that have lower
drop rates.
[Attributes - Volume 3]
If you think of human as being an attribute, does that mean there's
attacks that works against all humans? The answer is yes.
There are certain weapons and skill that are very effective against
humans. There may even be an attribute that all humans are weak to.
[Buffs and Debuffs]
Buffs are status effects that strengthen your party members.
Debuffs are status effects that weaken your enemies.
Buffs can increase your party's attack and defense. Both skills
and magic can be used to buff the party. It's simple, but you'll
see the value in it if your battle is dragging on.
Debuffs can lower your enemy's attacks and defense. Both skills
and magic can be used to debuff enemies. The stronger the enemy
the more value you'll get out of them.
[Maximum Number of Items]
You can carry up to 99 each of any human-made item, Healing Water,
and Reviver.
For natural items like Sakura Leave and Spirit Stones, you can
carry up to 9999 of each.
Even if the effect is the same, the different maximums have
different usages. The bigger maximums are used in exploration,
and the lower maximums are used in battle.
[The Kingdom of Elegance Lace]
The Silver Knight, Lace, wanted to found a country of peace in
accordance with Saint Bohelos's teachings.
Using their special, non-lethal spearmanship and diplomacy, Lace
was able to win their battles. Their style of battle became a
hot topic across the continent
In recent years, due to the large number of battles it's faced and
strong domestic demands, Lace has formed an orthodox knight order.
There's a note at the end of the book:
Lace has lost its territory and is no longer a country.
猿の王国の前身
[The Kingdom of Blades, Yaldapa]
A country with a long history, famous for its characteristic swords.
Known for both its famous swords and strong swordsmanship.
Many of Yaldapa's queens have been master swordfighters and greatly
admired by their people. The sword dance the queen performs at
the nation's festivals is admired throughout the continent.
Cooking knives made with Yaldapa's smithing techniques are in high
demand all over the continent. Every household has a Yaldapa knife.
The weight of the blade alone can cut tomatoes into thin slices.
There's a note at the back of the book:
Yaldapa has lost its territory and is no longer a country.
マーク６の前身
[Kingdom of Lohba]
A verdant nation situated next to the Ancient Lake. Perhaps
due to the majesty of the lake, the people have very calm
temperaments.
Sandwiched between the Rooklook's walls and the Ancient Lake,
they are very tenacious in battle. Lohba has a reputation as a
small but impregnable country.
A note at the end of the book says:
Lohba has lost its territory and is no longer a country.

[Ultimate Skill Animation Skip]
When you spend all your time battling, you prefer efficiency.
Having to sit through too many animations becomes a real drag.
So skip them! Use as many Ultimate Skills as you like without
having to sit through the animation every time!

luck? Don't you think it's important to bring good luck?
Luck is strongly connected to status effects. Higher luck means

You lose nothing by increasing your luck, so get out there and

[Luck]
Are you looking down on the items and equipment that increase your
luck? Don't you think it's important to bring good luck?
Luck is strongly connected to status effects. Higher luck means a
higher chance of being able to Stun the enemy, or resist being
Paralyzed in battle.
You lose nothing by increasing your luck, so get out there and
find yourself more of it!
[Return]
When you want to return quickly from a dungeon, you might find the
Return Scroll useful.
They're especially useful when dealing with deep dungeons, or
dungeons that contain a lot of strong enemies. You always want to
carry at least one.
An even more useful item is the Hometown Ocarina. This item is
reusable, so if you find it don't be afraid to use it.

[Hidden Treasure]
There are hidden treasures in this world that have yet to
be discovered.
If you manage to get your hands on them, they'll probably
provide incredible powers... If they truly exist.
[Healing Mist]
Back before there was magic, people thought they could heal
their injuries with herbs and inner spirit.
The strangest idea of all was the idea that scents could heal. By
smelling certain herbs or musks, a person could heal their body.
The method of making it has been lost, but of all these treatments
Heal Mist is by far the most effective. It has outstanding healing
qualities, so be bold yet prudent when you have some.
[Battle Ocarina]
When you need to fight enemies over and over, this is where the
Battle Ocarina comes into play.
Play the Battle Ocarina, and even if you've cleared your current
area of enemies, a battle will start.
Use it to farm for XP, drops, anything you need.
